verdict.rationale: Pulumi provides the building blocks: `pulumi preview` as a no-change plan step, Pulumi Policies as code-defined guardrails with violations surfaced in pull request checks, and ESC acting as an OIDC provider for credential issuance. Agent-facing marketing promises Neo has "enterprise controls built in" and keeps agents from going "off the rails", but no evidence documents how an agent is actually bound to approval gates or scoped credentials. Missing for 10: documented least-privilege/scoped credential setup for agents, explicit human approval gates blocking agent-initiated `up`/apply, detail on how Neo's controls enforce review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
